segments.name: microdisplay technologies and optical systems
segments.description: Designs and manufactures microdisplays and optical subsystems for defense, enterprise, industrial, consumer, and medical sectors.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it operates in one operating segment and one reportable segment, as the CODM reviews financial information presented on a consolidated basis for purposes of making operating decisions, allocating resources, and evaluating financial performance.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for displays, optical components, and ASOS it manufactures, plus customer-funded development contracts, licenses and royalties.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue generation derives primarily from the sale of displays, optical components, and ASOS that we manufacture for defense, industrial, medical and training and simulation applications, alongside customer-funded development contracts for U.S. defense programs.
